routes.what: Sign up, link card or click through before shopping, scan receipts, earn cash back on planned purchases
routes.reward: Points for scanning receipts (25+ pts/receipt); converts to gift cards
routes.requirements: 18+, US resident, phone number or email (no card needed), smartphone
routes.payout_timing: Points credited within minutes to hours; $3 gift cards available after a first $10+ redemption; redemption takes up to 72 hours
routes.catches: Points expire after 90 days of inactivity; max 35 receipts per rolling 7 days; 1,000 pts is worth about $0.67-$0.83 depending on retailer; excludes returns, bills/invoices, tickets, ATM/wire slips
routes.time_to_first: Weeks (first $10 gift card); points post within minutes

steps.text: Go to https://fetch.com or download the Fetch app from the App Store or Google Play
Create an account with email and password, or sign in with Google/Apple/Facebook
Enter any signup bonus code if available (search online for current referral codes)
steps.warns: Upmore shows: many cashback apps offer $5-$10 signup bonus with referral code

steps.text: Link your credit or debit card if the app supports card-linked offers (Plaid connection)
steps.warns: Upmore shows: card linking enables passive cash back — you earn automatically when you shop

steps.text: Before any online purchase, open the app/extension and search for the store you're shopping at
steps.warns: Upmore shows: only shop for things you'd buy anyway — cash back is not a reason to spend

steps.text: Click through the app's link to the store and complete your purchase as normal
steps.warns: Upmore shows: must click through the app link — going directly to the store won't earn cash back

steps.text: For receipt-based apps: scan your receipt in the app within 14 days of purchase
steps.warns: Upmore shows: scan within 7 days of purchase for most apps

steps.text: Wait for cash back to be confirmed by the merchant (typically 1-90 days depending on store)
Cash out when you reach the minimum (first gift card $10+, then $3+)
steps.warns: Upmore shows: minimum payout ranges from $1 to $30 depending on the app

steps.text: Screenshot the payout and log in Proof Log

steps.text: Complete the study or test: follow every instruction, stay focused, provide thoughtful feedback
steps.warns: Upmore shows: rushing = rejection = fewer future matches; quality matters

steps.text: Wait for approval and payment (typically 7-14 days)
steps.warns: Upmore tracks the payment timeline per platform

steps.text: Screenshot the payment and log in Proof Log
Stack with 2-3 platforms simultaneously for more opportunities

steps.warns: Upmore shows: exact reward, deposit tier, and deadline pulled from official page

steps.text: Confirm eligibility: age 18+, US residency, and that you don't already have (or recently had) an account there

steps.text: Click through the offer link (not just the app homepage) so the promo attaches, and create your Robinhood account
steps.warns: Upmore shows: using the direct offer link matters — going in through the app store alone may not attach the bonus

steps.text: Complete identity verification: legal name, date of birth, SSN, and address; upload a government ID photo if asked
steps.warns: Upmore never stores your SSN or ID

steps.text: Link your bank account via Plaid or manual routing/account number entry
Deposit the exact qualifying amount stated in the offer — note the exact tier if reward scales with deposit size
steps.warns: Upmore shows: depositing more than needed doesn't increase most rewards, but depositing less may disqualify you entirely

steps.text: Hold the account open and funded for the entire required period stated in the terms (commonly 30-90 days)
steps.warns: Upmore sends a reminder before the early-closure risk window ends

steps.text: Check your account for the posted stock or cash reward after the verification period
steps.warns: Upmore shows: if reward is stock, its value can go up or down before you sell

steps.text: Screenshot the reward confirmation and log it in Upmore's Proof Log

steps.text: Go to https://chase.com/personal/checking/checking-account-bonus and search for the current checking account bonus offer page (search 'Chase Total Checking checking bonus' if not on homepage)
steps.warns: Upmore shows: bonus amount, direct deposit requirement, deadline, and eligible states pulled from official page

steps.text: Confirm you're in an eligible state and haven't held a same-bank checking account within the bank's stated restriction period (commonly 12 months)
steps.warns: Upmore shows: this is the #1 reason bonuses get clawed back

steps.text: Open the account online through the offer link — copy any promo code shown and apply it during application

steps.text: In your payroll/HR system (Workday, ADP, Gusto, etc.), add this new account's routing and account number
steps.warns: Upmore shows: tip — you can often split your deposit, sending only the required amount here

steps.text: Confirm each direct deposit lands and is categorized by the bank as a qualifying direct deposit
steps.warns: Upmore shows: some banks exclude transfers from other banks, peer-to-peer payments, or ACH pushes

Complete KYC: full legal name, date of birth, SSN, residential address, and upload ID
steps.warns: Upmore shows: Kalshi is CFTC-regulated; SSN required for compliance

steps.text: Verify your state allows Kalshi trading — check their state availability page
steps.warns: Upmore shows: Some states restrict event-contract trading

steps.text: Deposit at least $10 via bank transfer or debit card
steps.warns: Upmore shows: $10 minimum — this is your money and is at risk

steps.text: Enter the current Kalshi promo code during signup or in the rewards section
steps.warns: Upmore shows: Verify promo code is active before depositing

steps.text: Trade at least $25 in event contracts (buy shares in any market outcome)
steps.warns: Upmore shows: Upmore does NOT recommend which contracts to trade — any trade can lose

steps.text: Confirm the $55 bonus credit appears in your account after qualifying volume
steps.warns: Upmore shows: Credit expires in 7 days — use it or lose it

steps.text: Use the bonus credit to trade additional event contracts before expiry
steps.warns: Upmore shows: You can lose the entire $55 bonus. Only trade markets you understand.

steps.text: Withdraw any realized gains to your linked bank account
steps.warns: Upmore shows: Only count withdrawn cash as earnings

steps.warns: Upmore shows: UGC platforms pay $50-$300 per video — higher than surveys but requires content creation

steps.text: Create a creator profile with truthful personal and payout information
Upload a short sample video of a product you own (30-60 seconds)

steps.text: Filter campaigns for disclosed cash payment and no required product purchase
steps.warns: Upmore shows: filter out campaigns that require buying the product unless reimbursed

steps.text: Read the campaign brief: content rights, payment amount, delivery date, revision rules, platform fee
steps.warns: Upmore shows: understand exactly what you're delivering and what rights the brand gets before applying

steps.text: Apply only to campaigns matching your device, format, location, and availability

steps.warns: Upmore shows: use Upmore's script template and shot list for each video type

steps.text: Edit the video: add captions, trim to length, ensure good lighting and audio
steps.warns: Upmore shows: Upmore can check hook, audio, lighting, product visibility before submission

steps.text: Submit through the platform and make revisions if requested
Get paid after approval (net of platform fees)
steps.warns: Upmore shows: net pay after platform fee — typically 10-20% commission

steps.text: Screenshot the payment and log in Proof Log
Build a portfolio of approved videos to increase acceptance rate for future campaigns
